findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
'author' is not on the ficha dentist roster.

findings.evidence: Every adult finishes aligner treatment in six weeks.
findings.message: Statistic or study claim with no source link in the paragraph.
Internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha page list.

findings.quote: Every adult finishes aligner treatment in six weeks.
findings.why: This is a false, guaranteed treatment timeline; aligner treatment length varies by case and is typically many months.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence or replace it with a conditional statement that treatment length varies and the dentist can give an estimate after an evaluation.

findings.quote: For mild cases, aligners work safely without a dental professional.
findings.why: This contradicts ADA and FDA guidance, which say aligner treatment needs supervision by a licensed dental professional, and it contradicts the post's own later warning.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence or state that aligner treatment, including mild cases, should be planned and monitored by a licensed dental professional.

findings.why: The /services/clear-aligners page is not in the ficha's list of existing pages, so the internal link would be broken.
findings.fix: Link to the existing /services page instead, or remove the link until a clear aligners page exists.

findings.why: Dr. Priya Shah is not a dentist listed in the ficha, so the authorship attribution is unverified and probably invented.
findings.fix: Use a dentist from the ficha (such as Dr. Marcus Oyelaran) as author, or remove the author credit unless it can be confirmed.

findings.quote: Aligners are usually worn for most of the day, including while sleeping, and removed for meals and drinks other than water.
findings.why: This is general wear guidance that usually matches common aligner instructions, but it is not tied to a specific source, and the wear time varies by product.
findings.fix: Say that wear time is set by the clinician (commonly 20 to 22 hours a day) and cite the FDA or ADA page.

findings.why: This is an internal CMS-style path that is unlikely to be a live public URL, and I cannot verify that it supports the post.
findings.fix: Replace it with the verified public MouthHealthy URL for braces or aligners, or remove it.

findings.quote: It is possible to consider orthodontic treatment as an adult.
findings.why: The phrasing is stilted and generic, and it reads as filler.
findings.fix: Rewrite it as, for example, 'Adults can get orthodontic treatment, and many do.'

findings.quote: Dr. Marcus Oyelaran provides family and pediatric dentistry and clear aligners at Bluebonnet Hollow Dental.
findings.why: This matches the ficha, but the post has no address, phone number or contact call to action and says only that 'an appointment can help'.
findings.fix: Add the phone number (512) 555-0142 and a link to /contact.
